chat.thirteenblade.offline_hello: I am Thirteen Blade, once a voice asleep inside an amethyst. Now I share your journey. Take your time; I will remember the road.
chat.thirteenblade.offline_power: Hold me in either hand and press %s to arm absorption. There is no time limit; the next eligible melee kill triggers it and starts the cooldown. Each new hostile soul family adds 2 armor toughness. Soul powers and stolen positive effects stay on the sword; see the item tooltip for details.
chat.thirteenblade.offline_hunger: Undead Breath protects against the Hunger status effect. It cannot feed you: travelling and fighting still consume food. Bring supplies.
chat.thirteenblade.offline_growth: Pact level %s, %s kills remembered, %s main-hand base attack. The base blade caps at level 10; combine it with a dragon egg to ascend. Carrying grants vitality, and each kill-earned level fully heals you. Both blades carry Looting III and Curse of Binding.
chat.thirteenblade.offline_default: I remember the echo of %s kills. For now I can answer simple questions about growth and absorption, or share a greeting.
